```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(sm)
library(lme4)
library(sjstats)
library(lsmeans)
library(Matching)
library(gplots)
library(stats)
```

```{r}
# READING CSV FILE WITH DATA FROM SURVEY 2, PART 2, WHERE THE BLACK INDIVIDUAL HAS A HIGHER LOAN REPAYMENT RATE

f22 <- f2_2_model
f22b <- f22
```

```{r}
# CREATING DFs WITH DATA OF ONLY ONE SIMILARITY METRIC/TREATMENT

f70 <- f22[!is.na(f22$`7040_1`),]
f100 <- f22[!is.na(f22$`10020_1`),]
f90 <- f22[!is.na(f22$`9010_1`),]
f55 <- f22[!is.na(f22$`5550_1`),]
```

```{r}
# CREATING BACKUP DFs

f100b <- f100
keeps <- c("ResponseId", "10020_1","10020_2","10020_3", "State", "Gender", "Race",  "Education",  "Community", "D6",  "D7")
f100 <- f100[ , keeps, drop = FALSE]
f100b <- f100
```
```{r}
f90b <- f90
keeps <- c("ResponseId", "9010_1","9010_2","9010_3", "State", "Gender", "Race",  "Education",  "Community", "D6",  "D7")
f90 <- f90[ , keeps, drop = FALSE]
f90b <- f90

f70b <- f70
keeps <- c("ResponseId", "7040_1","7040_2","7040_3", "State", "Gender", "Race",  "Education",  "Community", "D6",  "D7")
f70 <- f70[ , keeps, drop = FALSE]
f70b <- f70

f55b <- f55
keeps <- c("ResponseId", "5550_1","5550_2","5550_3", "State", "Gender", "Race",  "Education",  "Community", "D6",  "D7")
f55 <- f55[ , keeps, drop = FALSE]
f55b <- f55
```

```{r}
plot(density(f55$`5550_2`))
```

```{r}
plot(density(f55$`5550_3`))
```

```{r}
# CONVERTING INTO LONG FORMAT 

library(reshape2)
f55l <- melt(f55, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "State", "Gender", "Race", "Education", "Community", "D7", "D6"))
View(f55l)
```
```{r}
f55l <- f55l[,c(1,9,10,2:8)]
```

```{r}
f70l <- melt(f70, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "State", "Gender", "Race", "Education", "Community", "D7", "D6"))
f70l <- f70l[,c(1,9,10,2:8)]
```
```{r}
f90l <- melt(f90, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "State", "Gender", "Race", "Education", "Community", "D7", "D6"))
f90l <- f90l[,c(1,9,10,2:8)]
```
```{r}
f100l <- melt(f100, id.vars = c("ResponseId", "State", "Gender", "Race", "Education", "Community", "D7", "D6"))
f100l <- f100l[,c(1,9,10,2:8)]
```


```{r}
# PLOTTING THE DISTRIBUTIONS OF THE DIFFERENT DECISIONS FOR EACH SIMILARITY METRIC/TREATMENT

library(sm)
par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 0.1), xpd=TRUE, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5, cex.main=1.5, cex.sub=1.5)
sm.density.compare(f55l$value, f55l$variable, xlab="Fairness rating", lty = c(1,1,1))
axis(1, at=seq(1, 10, by=1))
title(main="Treatment 1: Distributions of the ratings for different decisions")
legend("topright",  bg = "transparent", legend=c("All A", "Equal", "Ratio"), col=c("red", "green", "blue"), lty=1:1, box.lty = 0, text.font=4)
```

```{r}
par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 0.1), xpd=TRUE, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5, cex.main=1.5, cex.sub=1.5)

```

```{r}
# PLOTTING THE MEANS OF THE DIFFERENT DECISIONS FOR EACH SIMILARITY METRIC/TREATMENT

library(gplots)
plotmeans(f55l$value ~ f55l$variable, data = f55l, mean.labels = TRUE, n.label = FALSE, xlab = "Possible decisions to split the $50,000", ylab = "Workers' fairness rating", legend=c("All A", "Equal", "Ratio"))
title(main = "Treatment 1: Comparison of means (with 95% CI)")
```
```{r}
plotmeans(f70l$value ~ f70l$variable, data = f70l, mean.labels = TRUE, n.label = FALSE, xlab = "Possible decisions to split the $50,000", ylab = "Workers' fairness rating", legend=c("All A", "Equal", "Ratio"))
title(main = "Treatment 2: Comparison of means (with 95% CI)")
```

```{r}
title(main = "Treatment 3: Comparison of means (with 95% CI)")
```


```{r}
## T tests 

print("T Tests")
print("TREATMENT 1 (55/50)")

print("Give all money to A versus Split 50/50")
t55a <- t.test(f55b$`5550_1`,f55b$`5550_2`)
print(t55a)
print("Give all money to A versus Split in Ratio")
t55b <- t.test(f55b$`5550_1`,f55b$`5550_3`)
print(t55b)
print("Split 50/50 versus Split in Ratio")
t55c <- t.test(f55b$`5550_2`,f55b$`5550_3`)
print(t55c)
```

```{r}
# Kolmogorov–Smirnov test
# ks.boot (bootstrapped version of the Kolmogorov–Smirnov test, which allows for ties
# with nboots = 10000

ks.boot(f55$`5550_2`, f55$`5550_3`, nboots=10000)

```

